predictions.rationale: Central class representing the Sequence Diagram itself, containing diagram behaviour and integration with the tool.
Factory that creates UMLSequenceDiagram instances; essential for constructing sequence diagrams from UI actions or loading.
Defines the underlying graph model (objects, lifelines, messages) that backs the Sequence Diagram view.
Responsible for visual rendering of sequence diagram elements on screen; directly supports the feature’s UI.
UI action that allows the user to create/open a Sequence Diagram; entry point from menus/toolbars.
Module descriptor that registers the sequence-diagram subsystem (factory, renderer) with ArgoUML.
Supplies property panels for sequence diagram elements, refining user interaction with the diagram.
Legacy/alternative sequence diagram class living in main app; still pertinent for feature support or backward compatibility.
Explorer navigation rule linking classifiers to their sequence diagrams, facilitating access to the feature.
Explorer rule that connects operations to relevant sequence diagrams, aiding feature integration in model navigation.
